item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish beef patty with roasted potatoes, gravy and soft onions, topped with cress. Served with cucumber salad and pickled beetroot. (6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Wok lo mein with noodles, pork, vegetables and lo mein sauce. Served with Asian slaw and crispy Chinese green beans. (1+2+3+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Wok lo mein with noodles, pea protein, vegetables and lo mein sauce. Served with Asian slaw and Chinese marinated crispy green beans. (1+2+3+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Chicken in an aromatic coconut and lime sauce, served with rice and crispy onions. (1+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Lentils in an aromatic coconut and lime sauce, served with rice and crispy onions. (1+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Roast chicken with butter-baked crushed potatoes and roasted vegetables. Served with ricotta cream and salsa verde. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Golden-fried halloumi with butter-baked crushed potatoes and roasted vegetables. Served with ricotta cream and salsa verde. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: North Indian butter chicken (lactose-free option available) with fluffy naan bread, topped with crispy namkeen. Served with lime and cumin raita, papaya chutney, fresh coriander and chilli sauce. (1+6+8+15) GREEN DISH: Dish North Indian butter paneer (or tofu tikka masala, vegan and lactose-free) with fluffy naan bread and crispy namkeen. Served with rice salad, lime and cumin raita, papaya chutney, fresh coriander and chilli sauce. (1+6+7+8+15)
